topography.project_purpose: Minimax is a multi-chain yield aggregator that optimizes user deposits across various DeFi protocols to maximize returns. It offers different strategy tiers (Base, Advanced, Main) and staking mechanisms, managed through upgradeable proxy contracts.
topography.relationship_narrative: Yield Strategies and Staking contracts are deployed as upgradeable proxies managed by ProxyAdmin, which is part of the Governance & Deployment family. The Deployments and Migrations contracts facilitate the initial setup and cross-chain replication of these core families.
